versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides keyword search, creator post capture, video comment extraction, and real-time Douyin trending queries, returning structured JSON data.
- Supports various content research scenarios, including trending topic tracking, competitor analytics, and comment sentiment analysis.
- Triggered for Douyin or general short video research; does not support publishing, editing, or non-Douyin platforms.
- Requires API token via environment variable; follows strict token management and error handling protocols.
- Outputs standardized JSON; logs and files are managed per documented guidelines.
